purpose: audit whether transfer-gain uncertainty statements hold simultaneously across all declared independent validation groups rather than interpreting separate per-group intervals as a familywise confidence statement

definition.resampling_unit: caller-declared blocks resampled with replacement within each independent validation group
definition.marginal_reference: ordinary two-sided percentile block-bootstrap interval at the requested confidence level for each group separately
definition.bonferroni_reference: two-sided percentile intervals using per-tail alpha/(2*group_count)
definition.max_t_statistic: for each bootstrap draw, maximum across estimable groups of absolute centered bootstrap mean deviation divided by that group's bootstrap standard error
definition.max_t_interval: point group mean plus/minus the common familywise max-t critical value times the group bootstrap standard error
definition.simultaneous_sign_rule: all max-t lower bounds above gain_tolerance for simultaneous robust generalizing; all max-t upper bounds at or below gain_tolerance for simultaneous robust non-generalizing
